shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json | head -100; cat src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts; cat src/transport/ws/validation.ts; cat src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | head -140; cat AGENTS.md | head -100'

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/types/sessionStore.ts; cat src/transport/createServer.ts | head -100; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | grep -n -C 3 spec; cat jest.config.js; cat src/infrastructure/stores/inMemoryConversationList.test.ts | head -90'
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.+#[0-9]' src/transport/*.test.ts | head; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100; git status -sb; ls scripts/spec-links"
/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat; rg -n '"'^it'"\\(' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]' src | head; cat scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -80"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"import type {AddressInfo} from 'node:net';\", \"import {once} from 'node:events';\\nimport type {AddressInfo} from 'node:net';\")
s=s.replace('    client.terminate();\\n    await hal.stop();', \"    const closed = once(client, 'close');\\n    client.close();\\n    await closed;\\n    await hal.stop();\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md')
s=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'],text=True)
s+='''\\n## Conversation list requests\\n\\n- A "'`list_conversations` request accepts an optional integer `limit` from 1 to 200 and an optional `before` cursor containing an ISO `updatedAt` and a `sessionId`; invalid fields are rejected and extra fields are ignored ([validated by: validates conversation list requests and their composite cursor](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L12)).'"\\n- When history is enabled, the server answers a request with one "'`conversation_list` containing only the authenticated connection user'"'s conversation summaries, newest first, with ISO times and no content; "'`limit` and `before` page the list ([validated by: lists only the authenticated user’s metadata and pages using the wire cursor](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L71)).'"\\n- When history is disabled, the server answers a list request with an "'`UNSUPPORTED` error ([validated by: refuses a list request when history is not enabled](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L90)).'"\\n'''
p.write_text(s)
PY
rg -n '"'^it'"\\(' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
git status -sb"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"    const closed = once(client, 'close');\\n    client.close();\\n    await closed;\", \"    const closed = once(client, 'close');\\n    const serverClosed = once([...hal.wss.clients][0]"'!, '"'close');\\n    client.close();\\n    await Promise.all([closed, serverClosed]);\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md
npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -65"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('test.ts#L71','test.ts#L72').replace('test.ts#L90','test.ts#L91')

PY
rg -n '"'^it'"\\(' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
